description: Find cloud GPUs to rent now: price per GPU hour and the stock each provider reported at the last daily check. Rentable offers come first, cheapest first. Each offer has a rent_url that opens the provider (some are referral links, same price for the buyer).

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. "H100", "B300", "RTX 4090". Omit for every model.

in_stock.description: Default true: only offers the provider reports in stock. false: also offers that are out of stock or have unknown stock, for a full market view.

limit.description: How many offers, default 20, at most 100.

min_gpus.description: Smallest node size needed, e.g. 8 for an 8x node.

name: find_gpu

captured_at.description: When the prices and stock were collected

is_referral.description: rent_url ends in a referral link; the buyer pays the same price

rent_url.description: Link to give the buyer; counts the click, then opens the provider

title: Find a GPU to rent
